pages.title: Navigation
pages.text: This section provides information about $(thing)navigation$() in $(item)Simply Journey$().
A utility item that allows you to search for a $(thing)biome's$() location anywhere in the world and view information about it.

When crafted, it has to be given away, dropped, found, or lost - and end up in someone else's inventory. $(br2)Right clicking this $(item)TelePass$() will then teleport the user to the creator of the TelePass unless when the creator is offline or in another dimension. $(br2)There are $(bold)2 tiers$().

This mod adds $(item)waystone$() blocks that the player can return to once they've been activated, either through a $(item)Warp Scroll$(), a rechargeable $(item)Warp Stone$(), or by using an existing waystone to hop from one to the other.
